selection_rules.new_orders: first five program-generated additions, ordered by appearance time
selection_rules.changed_orders: randomly sampled from PM customers whose service begins after the reception window
selection_rules.collision_avoidance: changed-order candidates exclude the coordinate proxies used by generated additions
selection_rules.event_ratio: 5 additions, 2 cancellations, 1 demand increase, 1 demand decrease, 1 time-window change
